title: Conditional κ = 0.001592517889315014: eight rank-five kernel pivots
body:
κ = 0.001592517889315014 (conditional).

This new finite witness is **0.034484749% above the tied #551/#552 value** 0.001591968902833346. It promotes eight post-center kernel pivots in pinned #552 from entrance rank four to rank five, then constructs a new chronological whole-owner assignment. Complex **b = 0.001595058047790616770328** binds; the cited unchanged #543 bit supplier has **c = 0.001653826988146798944268**. Concurrent #555 raises bit headroom but does not change this complex-bound minimum.

Two complete four-pivot groups change entrance and kernel frames while retaining every scalar instruction and coefficient. The helper inventory becomes `{4:8,5:48,8:156,9:292}`. The local profile is `{1:2316,2:424,3:464,4:192,5:56,6:56,8:8}`. After literal owner admission, the complete paid profile is `{1:166880,2:30528,3:35779,4:13824,5:4032,6:4032,7:208,8:576,39:1,48:1660}`. These complete profiles are priced; estimated gains are not added. Promoting all 48 eligible pivots loses after packing costs.

The offline verifier reconstructs the pinned #552 provider from primitive inputs and applies the deterministic promotion. It checks all 728 formal columns in both orientations, every arbitrary dirty helper, both reflected paid ledgers, 44 retained and eight new omitted-pivot controls, 11 native controls and normalized wrappers. It recompiles all 2,929 phase edges and 224 endpoint adapters, checks all 36,288 literal helper roles and seven owner corruptions, and derives a fresh finite invoice. Both rational moment engines certify the endpoints and reject adjacent ticks; seven finite bootstrap levels satisfy all 47 strict outer constraints. Four outer and 13 malformed-admission controls reject.

```sh
python -B research/complex-rank5-pivots8/verify.py --work /absolute/new/output
```

Python 3.11+ and NumPy; no network, optimizer, GPU or C++ compiler is needed for replay. Full packaged replay and a separate clean archive replay pass locally. Receipts are retained in `research/complex-rank5-pivots8-validation`. Dedicated 3.11/3.14 CI is provided; GitHub CI is separate and is not claimed green. The owner list is serialized in asynchronous invocation order, then helper order, matching the unchanged emitter and independent chart-stream auditor. Actual prefix 225 is below charged 512; row coefficient 16,467 is below 20,161.

This is a **new branch and new PR**. All earlier published heads and claims remain frozen. The construction changes starts/helper widths and repacks owners, so it is outside #557's fixed-boundary/fixed-owner frame ceiling and the analogous independently checked #552 frame-only model.

The numerical claim remains **conditional** on inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic-transfer contracts. The bit supplier's interleaved source writes retain its stated H1–H5 interface premise. This package cites and exactly reprices #543, rather than claiming a fresh bit rebuild. No unconditional multiplication theorem, complete Lean proof or practical speedup is claimed.

Prepared for eumemic with **OpenAI Codex assistance**. Credits and original AI disclosures are retained for Dugongue #552/#548/#541; chafreaky #551; rohanarun/Claude #534; icekylinx #535/#531; DreamingOfClouds #484 and the attributed kernel, phase, normalized-wrapper and arithmetic ancestry; eumemic/Claude #543; eumemic/Codex #550's hardened assembly; and lydakis #275's retained finite-frontier method.
